FOUNDATION

RESPONSIBILITY MODEL

HEIMDALL — ORGANIZE & UNDERSTAND.

♬ CONDUCTOR — shared orchestration/intelligence fabric.

LCAS — truthful live control/activity/status; not orchestration.

MANY APPS, ONE AUTHORITY PER CAPABILITY, MINIMAL DUPLICATION.
REUSE → COMPOSE → EXTEND → ADAPT → EXTRACT → BUILD NEW.
LINK → TAB / WEBAPP → EMBED → NATIVE.

AI execution: RECOMMENDED / NATIVE / LOCAL / CONNECTED / CUSTOM.
NATIVE ≠ LOCAL ≠ CONNECTED. Deterministic-first; provider-neutral.
Generated ≠ Saved ≠ Verified ≠ Consolidated ≠ Released.
